lastCompletedStory.title: Add cam spec --persist <id> in-process CLI mode with CAM_SPEC_RESULT handback

nextStoryContext: US-002 rewrites the /cam-spec persist final step (both templates/commands/cam-spec.md and .claude/commands/cam-spec.md, per the self-hosting invariant) to pipe the assembled JSON into `cam spec --persist <id>` instead of a throwaway bun script. runSpecPersist (src/commands/spec.ts) and dispatchSpec's mode:'persist' branch (index.ts) are in place and tested (test/commands/spec.test.ts). Usage: `echo '<json>' | cam spec --persist <id>` where <json> is `{ spec: Spec, wsjf: WsjfScore, blockedBy?: string[] }` (Spec = { acceptanceCriteria: string[], scope: string, gotchas: string[], domainTerms: string[] }, WsjfScore = { value, timeCriticality, riskReduction, jobSize }). On success it prints `CAM_SPEC_RESULT=<id> sha=<sha>` and exits 0; on failure it prints `CAM_SPEC_RESULT=ERROR reason=<reason>` and exits 1 (reasons: invalid-spec, invalid-wsjf, not-found, wrong-stage, not-open, integrity-error, diverged, detached-head, missing-main, invalid-json). SPEC_HELP already documents --persist. No re-validation needed in the prompt doc: specifyIssueOnMain does full guard/validation, the CLI only marshals stdin JSON.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure internal wiring: CLI arg parsing (index.ts) + stdin JSON marshalling into the already-tested specifyIssueOnMain primitive (issue-specify.ts, node:child_process/Bun builtins only, no new external dependency).
